header.title: WhatsApp Business
header.subtitle: Send account statements and transaction alerts automatically via WhatsApp

connection.title: Link WhatsApp
connection.qrPlaceholder: Press "Start Linking" to show the QR code
connection.step3: Tap the three dots ← Linked Devices
connection.step4: Tap "Link a Device" and scan the QR code

schedule.title: Automatic Send Schedule
schedule.enableDesc: Sends statements automatically according to the schedule

accounts.title: Accounts to Export
accounts.searchPlaceholder: Account number or name (F9 to search)

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.groupPlaceholder: Group name as it appears in WhatsApp
recipients.groupsHint: Type the group name exactly as it appears in WhatsApp

tx.title: Transaction Alerts
tx.enableDesc: Sends an instant WhatsApp notification when a selected financial transaction is executed
tx.recipientsSub: Add the numbers and groups that will receive transaction notifications
tx.eventsSub: Choose the transactions you want to be notified about
tx.saveHint: Changes are not applied until saved

promo.title: Promotional Messages
promo.enableDesc: Sends the promotional message automatically according to the schedule
promo.messageSub: Paste or type the message to send
promo.messagePlaceholder: Type or paste the promotional message here...
promo.scheduleSub: When to send the promotional message automatically
promo.recipientsSub: Phone numbers or groups and communities that will receive the message
promo.groupsHint: Type the name exactly as it appears in WhatsApp

balances.title: Customer, Supplier & Account Balances
balances.enableDesc: Sends the current SAR / gold / silver balances for enabled customers, suppliers, and accounts according to the schedule
balances.scheduleSub: Choose when current balances are sent automatically
balances.ignoreZeroDesc: If the customer/supplier/account balance is zero SAR, zero gold, and zero silver, no message will be sent
balances.addSub: Press the selection button or F9 to open the search window, then click an item to add it
balances.searchPlaceholder: Press F9 or the selection button to open search
balances.targetsHint: You can fill both a WhatsApp number and a group name; the same customer/supplier/account balance will be sent to both.
balances.listSub: Enable or disable each customer/supplier/account and set their WhatsApp number or group
balances.empty: No customers, suppliers, or accounts added yet
balances.lookupSearchPlaceholder: Type number or name to search...
balances.groupPlaceholder: Group name as it appears in WhatsApp

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.disconnectMsg: Do you want to temporarily disconnect WhatsApp?
confirm.logoutMsg: Do you want to log out of WhatsApp on this device?
confirm.deleteAccountMsg: Do you want to delete account "{name}"?
